coordinate_convention: Canonical crystal centre is global origin; detector front is +z; millimetres.
scope: GeGI front-layer dimensions with an explicitly nominal cylindrical side/rear enclosure; not an as-built cryostat or calibrated efficiency model.

measured_front.source: Owner-held PHDS GeGI5-CryostatMaterials- 20200204, page 1, section L-L; dimensions in mm. Drawings are not distributed.

nominal_enclosure.basis: Explicit modelling choices for missing side/rear dimensions and the undimensioned split of the 5.7 mm total front vacuum gap; these values are not surveyed dimensions.

radiation_material.approximation: Both named aluminium alloys are represented as pure aluminium at Geant4 NIST density. Alloy composition is not supplied and is not invented.

omitted: finite contact metallisation and dead layers
